notice: Edge probes of the replay lab. Synthetic inputs designed to stress the interest stream beyond the seven golden fixtures. They have no golden file: the observed side is the legacy lane run at replay time, and nothing is recorded under fixtures/.

probes.name: p01-tie-ladder
probes.title: Rounding ties, positive
probes.stresses: Four balances of one account at 12.00 %, each exactly half a cent of interest: 0.015, 0.025, 12.355 and 12.365. Truncation, half-up and half-even give three different totals (24.74, 24.78, 24.76), so the account balance shows which one an engine used. A second account closes the file.

probes.name: p02-tie-negative
probes.title: Rounding ties, negative
probes.stresses: Credit balances whose interest is exactly minus half a cent: -0.025 and -12.355. Cutting off towards zero gives -0.02 and -12.35; rounding down (floor) or half-up away from zero would give -0.03 and -12.36.

probes.name: p03-last-account
probes.title: The last account on the file
probes.stresses: Three accounts with balances; the last one has two balances and non-zero cycle amounts, and it is not the last record of the account file (account 3013 follows it there with no balance). The legacy program updates 3010 and 3011, writes the transactions of 3012 but leaves its balance and cycle amounts as they were, and never touches 3013.

probes.name: p04-no-disclosure-group
probes.title: An account with no disclosure group
probes.stresses: Account 3020 has an empty group id. Both of its balances have no rate of their own, so each falls back to the group DEFAULT with the two messages in the job log: the purchase balance is charged at 21.00 %, the payment balance has the DEFAULT rate 0 and gets no transaction. Account 3021 closes the file.

probes.name: p05-negative-balance
probes.title: Negative balances
probes.stresses: Account 3030 has a debit and a larger credit balance, so its interest nets to -12.50 and the account balance goes down. Account 3031 has no group and a credit balance of -300.10: DEFAULT rate, interest -5.25175 cut off towards zero to -5.25, and as the last account its balance is not changed.

probes.name: p06-sub-cent-inactive
probes.title: Interest below one cent, inactive account
probes.stresses: Balances of 0.50 and -0.50 at 12.00 % give +0.005 and -0.005, both cut off to zero: a 0.00 transaction is still written (INT-Q06), and the second one is a zero with a negative origin. The account is inactive (INT-H04) and is charged all the same. Account 3041 closes the file.

probes.name: p07-stop-missing-account
probes.title: The run stops: account missing from the account file
probes.stresses: INT-R08. Account 3051 has a balance and a card but no record on the account file. The run stops at its balance: 'ACCOUNT NOT FOUND', 'ERROR READING ACCOUNT FILE', the file status, 'ABENDING PROGRAM'. Account 3050 before it has already been charged. Compared: how the run ended, the return code and the job log.

probes.name: p08-stop-missing-card
probes.title: The run stops: no card cross-reference
probes.stresses: INT-R08. Account 3061 is on the account file but has no card in the cross-reference. The run stops at its balance: 'ACCOUNT NOT FOUND', 'ERROR READING XREF FILE', the file status, 'ABENDING PROGRAM'. Compared: how the run ended, the return code and the job log.

probes.name: p09-stop-missing-default-rate
probes.title: The run stops: no DEFAULT rate
probes.stresses: INT-R08 after INT-R03. Account 3071 is in group SILVER, which has no rate, and the rate table has no DEFAULT row either. The fallback is tried, then the run stops: 'ERROR READING DEFAULT DISCLOSURE GROUP', the file status, 'ABENDING PROGRAM'. Compared: how the run ended, the return code and the job log.

probes.name: p10-run-twice
probes.title: Open question INT-H02: the job run twice
probes.stresses: INT-H02, an open question, not a rule. The job is run a second time on the files the first run left. Nothing stops it: both runs write the same transaction ids and the interest is added to the balance twice (1000.00, 1010.00, 1020.00). Every amount is exact to the cent, so rounding plays no part. This shows what each engine does today, not what is right.

probes.name: p11-two-cards
probes.title: Open question INT-H03: two cards on one account
probes.stresses: INT-H03, an open question, not a rule. Account 3081 has two cards. The source does not say which card number its interest transaction gets, or whether the run stops. This shows what each engine does today, not what is right; the legacy side is GnuCOBOL, which may differ from the host on the duplicate-key read.
